$comment: Captured from the Node CLI on Windows by ../capture-run.mjs; tests/windows_node_parity.rs runs the same target against the native binary on the cache the cold run wrote. `workspace` is a directory below tests/fixtures.

cases.name: fsorder
cases.note: Directories that are not in byte order (mixed case, `_`, digits) holding packages whose names rise in the order Node finds the directories in (the file system's), so the tasks start and are listed in one order.

cases.name: order
cases.note: Directories and ids in different orders (mixed case, `_`, a directory named unlike its package). Node starts the tasks by id and lists the projects in NTFS order; the binary hands the run back.

cases.name: chain
cases.note: Workspace dependencies: Node starts tasks deepest project first, before the id order; the binary does not read the dependencies and hands the run back on Windows.
